title: Large Flow Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28559v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for

translated_abstract: 连续流语言模型为实现并行生成提供了一条路径，并具备离散扩散模型所不具备的控制与加速工具，然而在数十亿参数规模上构建此类模型的有效技术尚未充分确立。我们提出了 Lafa（Large flow language model，大型流语言模型），这是一个快速、高性能的流语言模型，以数据高效的方式扩展至 80 亿参数。Lafa 是一种分块流模型，在前缀部分采用因果注意力，并在每个块内进行双向、异步的流建模。这一设计使其能够通过改造预训练的自回归（AR）模型实现高效训练，并借助前缀缓存和分块并行解码实现快速推理。我们在 0.5B、7B 和 8B 规模上训练了 Lafa，使用的数据少于 300 亿 token，比以往的扩散模型更加高效；并在指令跟随、推理和编码任务上对其进行评估，结果表明学习到的流模型质量可匹敌甚至超越自回归模型，并且可以被蒸馏为流映射以……
tldr: 提出了 Lafa——一个可扩展至 80 亿参数的分块流语言模型，通过改造预训练自回归模型实现高效训练，并借助前缀缓存与分块并行解码实现快速推理，在指令跟随、推理和编码任务上达到或超越自回归模型的性能。
en_tdlr: Lafa is a blockwise flow language model scaled to 8B parameters that efficiently adapts pretrained autoregressive models for training and achieves fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding, matching or surpassing AR model quality on instruction following, reasoning, and coding tasks.
